tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs sed+ge'i sgra yab yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ ma lus rgyal ba'i ye shes kun/ /gcig bsdus gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes grags pa der/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i sed+ge yab yum sgrub par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las auṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba la byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can ster nus pa'i byed las dang ldan par gyur/ auṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ lha bskyed pa ni/ auṃ shūn+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las siṃ las sed+ge sngon po ral ba dmar ser gyen du phyogs pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la dhī:las ral gri dhī:sa mtshan pa dang*/ rang gi mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas ral gri hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ 'dzum zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas ut+pa la'i sdong bu'i yu ba nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'dab ma'i steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang*/ sher phyin gyi glegs bam gyis mdzes pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/

'od kyi phung po'i dbus na 'gying ba dang bcas te zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum lha mo dbyangs can ma sngon mo khro 'dzum gyis mdzes shing lang tsho rgyas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ 'gying bag dang bcas te bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ de gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs smra seng yab yum spyan drangs auṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī swa ra swa ti sa pā ri wa ra ai h+yi hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzung nas auṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ auṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī ye swa ra swa sti ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod de/ mtha' yas 'gro la rnam dpyod spobs pa mchog /stsol mdzad rgyal ba'i yab gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /yum mchog tshangs sras lha mo dbyangs can ma'i/ /zhabs la gus 'dud rnam dpyod mchog stsol mdzod/ /rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyur pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dmar ser rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar ral gri sngon po sor bzhi pa'i 'chang bzung la dhīḥs mtshan pa/ de'i mthar sngags phreng kha dog dmar ser gyen du 'greng nas g.yas skor du 'khor bar gyur/ dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon/ dbyangs can ma'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs te thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar ral gri sngon po 'chang bzung la hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa la thim/

slar 'thon yum gyi shangs bug g.yas nas byung*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying ga'i sa bon la thim zhing mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar gyur bar bsams te/ auṃ dhīḥhrīḥm me dī baṃ mañdzu shri ye mu hrīḥpradz+nyā war+dha ni dhīḥhrīḥswāhā/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig yin la/ gzhan ci 'grub bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod cing gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs zhes sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i sed+ge yab yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ auṃ ār+ya mañdzu shri ye swa ra swa sti sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul te/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po/ / zhes sogs sam/ sngar gyi bstod pas bstod de/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis 'dod don zhu gsol bya/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol byas nas/ ye shes pa rang la thim par gyur/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces pa gang rung byas te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs spyi 'gre ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs zab mo zhig yin no// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'jam dbyangs seṅge'i sgra yab yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/
